cases.title: Link configured support terms in one plain-text help article
cases.description: The fixed glossary is reused across articles. Inserted links contain dictionary terms and must not be searched again; sequential str_replace is intentionally not equivalent. Input text is owned and HTML escaping is outside this operation.
cases.origin: Project-authored deterministic workload model; not a production trace.
cases.contract: Exact case-sensitive bytes; no word-boundary rules, normalization, or case folding.

modes.label: Worker with the same dictionary already prepared

lifetime.pcre_note: Pattern keys can remain cached when only replacement values change; report warm and fresh-process compilation separately.

cases.str_replace_note: Excluded: no equivalence with this replacement policy is claimed.

documents.text:
Finding a parcel

Use the order number from your receipt to open order tracking. The tracking number identifies the parcel with the courier, while order status describes our warehouse work. A delivery date is an estimate until the parcel reaches your local depot.

If the shipping address changed after checkout, contact customer support. Include the old delivery address and the new one in a private support ticket. Do not post an email address in a public review.

expected.text: Finding a parcel Use the order number from your receipt to open order tracking. The tracking number identifies the parcel with the courier, while order status describes our warehouse work. A delivery date is an estimate until the parcel reaches your local depot. If the shipping address changed after checkout, contact customer support. Include the old delivery address and the new one in a private support ticket. Do not post an email address in a public review.

documents.text:
Returning one item

A return label can be downloaded from your account. Check the return window before sending the parcel. The shipping label used for the original delivery cannot be reused as a return label.

A partial refund applies when only part of the order is returned. Refund status is updated after the warehouse checks the item. Keep the postal receipt until payment confirmation arrives.

expected.text: Returning one item A return label can be downloaded from your account. Check the return window before sending the parcel. The shipping label used for the original delivery cannot be reused as a return label. A partial refund applies when only part of the order is returned. Refund status is updated after the warehouse checks the item. Keep the postal receipt until payment confirmation arrives.

documents.text:
Paying for an order

The payment method is shown on the invoice. If payment failed, review the billing address and ask your bank whether the transaction was declined. A duplicate authorization is not necessarily a second payment.

A discount code is applied before sales tax. The currency is displayed at checkout. A gift card and store credit can cover part of the balance, with the remaining amount paid by another payment method.

expected.text: Paying for an order The payment method is shown on the invoice. If payment failed, review the billing address and ask your bank whether the transaction was declined. A duplicate authorization is not necessarily a second payment. A discount code is applied before sales tax. The currency is displayed at checkout. A gift card and store credit can cover part of the balance, with the remaining amount paid by another payment method.

documents.text:
Managing access

Use password reset when you no longer know your password. A verification code confirms a single sign-in attempt. Two-factor authentication can also use a security key, depending on your account settings.

If a session expired message appears during checkout, sign in again before submitting payment. Review the privacy policy for information about data export and data deletion. Customer support never asks you to post a password in live chat.

expected.text: Managing access Use password reset when you no longer know your password. A verification code confirms a single sign-in attempt. Two-factor authentication can also use a security key, depending on your account settings. If a session expired message appears during checkout, sign in again before submitting payment. Review the privacy policy for information about data export and data deletion. Customer support never asks you to post a password in live chat.

documents.text:
Choosing a product

The product page lists each product variant and its current stock. Use the size guide before adding an item to your basket. An out of stock variant can be added to saved items so you can check it later.

The warranty period is recorded on the receipt. A replacement part may solve a small fault without replacing the complete product. Include a photo and the invoice number when opening a warranty support ticket.

expected.text: Choosing a product The product page lists each product variant and its current stock. Use the size guide before adding an item to your basket. An out of stock variant can be added to saved items so you can check it later. The warranty period is recorded on the receipt. A replacement part may solve a small fault without replacing the complete product. Include a photo and the invoice number when opening a warranty support ticket.

documents.text:
Collecting a delivery

A pickup point may request the tracking number and proof of identity. The courier sends a notification when the parcel is available. Read the delivery instructions before travelling to collect it.

A warehouse delay can move the delivery date by one business day. A weekend or holiday may affect support hours. For urgent changes use the contact form and include your order number.

expected.text: Collecting a delivery A pickup point may request the tracking number and proof of identity. The courier sends a notification when the parcel is available. Read the delivery instructions before travelling to collect it. A warehouse delay can move the delivery date by one business day. A weekend or holiday may affect support hours. For urgent changes use the contact form and include your order number.

documents.text:
Using the mobile site

The mobile app and browser share your account settings. A screen reader can announce checkout errors and form labels. If a photo upload fails, check the attachment size before trying file upload again.

Accessibility feedback can be sent through the contact form. Do not attach an invoice containing another customer's billing address. A support ticket can be reopened if the requested attachment was missing.

expected.text: Using the mobile site The mobile app and browser share your account settings. A screen reader can announce checkout errors and form labels. If a photo upload fails, check the attachment size before trying file upload again. Accessibility feedback can be sent through the contact form. Do not attach an invoice containing another customer's billing address. A support ticket can be reopened if the requested attachment was missing.

documents.text:
Subscriptions and gifts

A subscription renewal produces a new invoice and payment confirmation. You can review the subscription in your account or cancel order dispatch before the displayed cutoff. Cancellation rules are listed in the privacy policy and service terms.

A gift message is printed separately from the receipt. International shipping may require a customs charge. The courier will explain how customs clearance affects the delivery date.

expected.text: Subscriptions and gifts A subscription renewal produces a new invoice and payment confirmation. You can review the subscription in your account or cancel order dispatch before the displayed cutoff. Cancellation rules are listed in the privacy policy and service terms. A gift message is printed separately from the receipt. International shipping may require a customs charge. The courier will explain how customs clearance affects the delivery date.

cases.title: Publish eight different help articles using one link glossary
cases.description: One publishing job applies one fixed term-to-link dictionary to eight distinct articles. This is exact literal linking, not word-boundary-aware natural-language processing.
cases.origin: Project-authored deterministic workload model; not a production trace.
cases.contract: Exact case-sensitive bytes; no word-boundary rules, normalization, or case folding.
